source: Strategy War v1.3.5 MIDP-2 (identical maps in v1.6.3)

missions.title: Beginning
missions.brief: Welcome to Strategy War - try to build a building, drive around and destroy some enemy buildings with no attacking enemy around. The goal is to destroy the enemy building

missions.title: Harvest
missions.brief: Build a silo, start harvesting and build some tanks and shoot down the enemy!

missions.title: Attack
missions.brief: Be careful about the enemy - he has a lot of resources now!

missions.title: Escape
missions.brief: Warning, enemy units everywhere, we must destroy their last and change position!

missions.title: Find it
missions.brief: Now you will learn to find the enemy base in heavy terrain and destroy it.

missions.title: Get me
missions.brief: The enemy forces are gaining on us, build as fast as you can!!

missions.title: Battle
missions.brief: The final battle for this area wont be easy.

missions.title: Search
missions.brief: Now let us see which way to go.

missions.title: Operation X
missions.brief: What do we do now? Escape?

missions.title: Finder
missions.brief: Enemy: "Prepare to by smashed! You have no cover!"

missions.title: Middle
missions.brief: Welcome to the arena, let us see how you battle!

missions.title: Crossing
missions.brief: You now had to change your position, be aware, the enemy has sent everything they got now, but we will see, if they use it this time.

missions.title: Open battle
missions.brief: Now let us see how you can do in open battle field.

missions.title: Another war
missions.brief: Enemy units have come very close this time. Destroy them!

missions.title: Can you?
missions.brief: Commander: "Are you able build everything yourself? Let us see. Build fast!"

missions.title: New map
missions.brief: You have just entered a new enemy territory - be aware that the enemy has called for reinforcements.

missions.title: Overload
missions.brief: The enemies sent their strongest units and are ready to destroy you. Attack them before they destroy you!

missions.title: Holdup
missions.brief: The enemy units are gaining on you from all sides. Make your walls stronger and build more tanks.

missions.title: The last
missions.brief: The enemy has called all last forces, that he has - he cannot stand it - destroy him!

missions.title: Now where?
missions.brief: Enemy: "Did you think that was the last? Well you were mistaken..."
